description: Named playbook chains composed from atomic per-module playbooks. Override any parameter via --var key=value.

to-cos.description: Create Schedule -> Approve Rates -> Approve Schedule (COS created)

to-tickets.description: Create Schedule -> Approve Rates -> Approve Schedule -> Record Dispatch Tickets

to-billing.description: Create Schedule -> Approve Rates -> Approve Schedule -> Record Tickets -> Prepare Billing

to-billing-approved.description: Schedule -> Rates -> COS -> Tickets -> Billing -> Commercial Review -> Final Approval

schedule-revise-flow.description: Create Schedule -> Approve Rates & Schedule -> Revise Approved Schedule -> Re-approve Schedule

billing-reject-flow.description: Reviewer rejects Billing {billingId} -> Encoder adjusts with PDF -> Reviewer endorses -> Finance approves

billing-reopen-flow.description: Finance reopens Approved Billing {billingId} -> Encoder adjusts with PDF -> Reviewer endorses -> Finance re-approves

collection-returned-flow.description: Create Check Collection for {billingId} -> Deposit -> Return Check -> Redeposit -> Cleared
